title: Chickpea & spinach coconut curry
steps: Rinse the rice and cook it in a pan of salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain and keep covered.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large deep pan over a medium heat.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft and just golden.
Stir in the garlic, ginger and curry powder and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes and coconut milk, then add the chickpeas.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until slightly thickened.
Stir through the spinach a handful at a time until wilted. Season with the salt.
Serve the curry spooned over the rice.

title: Slow-cooker red lentil dahl
steps: Put the lentils, onion, garlic, ginger and all the spices into the slow cooker.
Add the chopped tomatoes, coconut milk and stock, and stir well.
Cover and cook on low for 4 hours (or high for 2½ hours), until the lentils have collapsed.
About 20 minutes before serving, cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Stir the dahl well. If it's too thick, loosen it with a splash of hot water.
Squeeze in the lemon juice and season with salt.
Scatter with cilantro and serve with the rice.

title: Smoky black bean tacos with lime slaw
steps: Toss the cabbage with the juice of 1 lime, half the cilantro and a pinch of salt. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and cook half the red onion for 4 minutes.
Add the black beans, paprika, cumin and chili powder with a splash of water.
Cook for 5 minutes, roughly mashing about a third of the beans with a fork.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds on each side and keep them wrapped in a clean tea towel.
Fill each tortilla with beans, slaw, avocado and a spoonful of salsa.
Finish with the remaining onion, cilantro and lime wedges for squeezing.

title: Peanut noodle stir-fry
steps: Soak the rice noodles in just-boiled water for 8 minutes, then drain.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, juice of half the lime, sriracha, sugar and 4 tbsp hot water into a smooth sauce.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat.
Fry the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the frozen vegetables and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 minutes until glossy and hot.
Serve topped with spring onions, peanuts and the remaining lime cut into wedges.

title: Roast veg & chickpea couscous
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Toss the zucchini, peppers, onion and chickpeas with 2 tbsp oil, the cumin, paprika and salt on a large tray.
Roast for 30 minutes, turning halfway, until the veg is soft and charred at the edges.
With 10 minutes to go, put the couscous in a bowl and pour over the hot stock.
Cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Stir the remaining oil and the lemon juice through the couscous.
Fold in the roast veg and chickpeas and scatter with parsley.

title: Sticky sesame cauliflower with rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Toss the cauliflower with the oil, then with 2 tbsp of the cornstarch until coated.
Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 15 minutes, shaking the basket halfway, until crisp.
Meanwhile, mix the soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, garlic, ginger, the last 1 tbsp cornstarch and 4 tbsp water.
Bubble the sauce in a small pan for 2 minutes until thick and glossy.
Toss the crispy cauliflower in the sauce.
Serve over the rice with sesame seeds and spring onions.

title: Lentil ragù spaghetti
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and gently cook the onion, carrot and celery for 8 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, chopped tomatoes, stock and oregano.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring often, until the lentils are tender and the sauce is thick.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water for 10 minutes, or according to the pack.
Season the ragù with salt and pepper, adding a splash of pasta water if it's too thick.
Toss the spaghetti through the sauce and serve.

title: Sweet potato & peanut curry
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potato, chopped tomatoes, coconut milk and peanut butter. Stir until the peanut butter melts in.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the sweet potato is tender.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Stir the spinach into the curry until wilted, then add the lime juice and salt.
Serve over rice, scattered with cilantro.

title: Microwave chickpea curry rice bowls
steps: Mix the chickpeas, passata, curry powder, garlic powder and a pinch of salt in a large microwave-safe bowl.
Cover and microwave on high for 3 minutes.
Stir in the spinach, cover again and microwave for 1 minute until wilted.
Heat the rice pouch in the microwave according to the pack, about 2 minutes.
Squeeze the lemon juice into the curry and stir.
Divide the rice between two bowls, top with the curry and finish with a spoonful of coconut yogurt.

title: Air-fryer halloumi & pepper wraps
steps: Toss the peppers and onion with the oil and paprika.
Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 6 minutes.
Add the halloumi slices to the basket and air fry for another 6 minutes, turning once, until golden.
Meanwhile, stir the cucumber and lemon juice into the yogurt with a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas in the air fryer for 1 minute.
Spread each tortilla with the yogurt, then add arugula, veg and halloumi.
Roll up tightly and cut in half to serve.

title: Shakshuka with crusty bread
steps: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan with a lid over a medium heat.
Cook the onion and pepper for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and chili flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes until slightly thickened. Season.
Make 4 dips in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks are still soft.
Scatter over the feta and parsley and serve straight from the pan with the bread.

title: Creamy tomato & spinach gnocchi bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Heat the oil in an ovenproof pan and fry the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the passata and oregano and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cream cheese until melted, then add the spinach until wilted.
Stir in the gnocchi straight from the pack so every piece is coated.
Top with the mozzarella and bake for 15 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Scatter with basil leaves and serve.

title: Mushroom & pea risotto
steps: Heat the oil and half the butter in a wide pan and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and garlic and cook for 5 minutes until golden.
Stir in the rice for 1 minute until the grains turn glossy.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, letting each addition absorb before adding the next. This takes about 18 minutes.
Stir in the peas with the last ladle of stock and cook for 2 more minutes.
Take off the heat and beat in the remaining butter, the parmesan and the lemon juice.
Season with pepper, cover and rest for 2 minutes before serving.

title: 2-minute burrito bowls
steps: Put the black beans and frozen corn in a microwave-safe bowl with 2 tbsp of the salsa.
Cover and microwave on high for 2 minutes, then stir.
Heat the rice pouch in the microwave according to the pack, about 2 minutes.
Divide the rice between two bowls and top with the beans and corn.
Add the remaining salsa, cheddar, avocado and a spoonful of sour cream.
Squeeze over the lime juice and serve.

title: Veggie egg fried rice
steps: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat.
Stir-fry the garlic and carrot for 2 minutes.
Add the peas and corn and cook for 2 minutes.
Squeeze the rice pouches to break up the grains, add to the pan and stir-fry for 4 minutes until hot.
Push the rice to one side, pour the eggs into the gap and scramble for 1 minute before mixing through.
Add the soy sauce and sesame oil and toss well.
Serve scattered with spring onions.

title: Paneer tikka traybake with naan
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Mix half the yogurt with the curry paste and lemon juice, then stir in the paneer to coat.
Toss the peppers and onion with the oil on a large tray and roast for 10 minutes.
Add the paneer to the tray and roast for 15 minutes more until charred at the edges.
Warm the naans in the oven for the last 3 minutes.
Season the remaining yogurt with a pinch of salt.
Pile the paneer and veg onto the naans, drizzle with yogurt and scatter with cilantro.

title: Air-fryer honey-soy salmon with greens
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Mix the honey, soy sauce, garlic and ginger in a small bowl.
Brush half the glaze over the salmon fillets.
Air fry the salmon at 200°C (400°F) for 8 minutes, brushing with the remaining glaze halfway.
Meanwhile, steam or boil the green beans for 4 minutes.
Serve the salmon on the rice with the beans, scattered with sesame seeds and spring onions.

title: Thai red prawn curry
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a wok or deep pan and fry the curry paste for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the pepper and green beans and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until pink all the way through.
Season with the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice.
Scatter with basil and serve with the rice.

title: Tuna & sweetcorn pasta bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Cook the penne in salted boiling water for 2 minutes less than the pack says, then drain.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a pan, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer for 3 minutes until thick and smooth.
Take off the heat and stir in the mustard and two-thirds of the cheddar.
Mix the pasta, tuna, corn and spring onions into the sauce and season with pepper.
Tip into a baking dish, scatter over the rest of the cheese and bake for 15 minutes until golden.

title: Lemon cod with crushed potatoes & beans
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and the salt on a tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Lightly crush the potatoes with a fork, then add the garlic, green beans and tomatoes.
Lay the cod on top, drizzle with the remaining oil and add a few lemon slices.
Roast for 12 to 15 minutes until the fish flakes easily.
Squeeze over the rest of the lemon, scatter with parsley and serve.

title: Garlic prawn spaghetti
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water for 10 minutes, or according to the pack. Save a mugful of pasta water.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat.
Fry the garlic and chili flakes for 1 minute without letting the garlic brown.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until they start to burst.
Add the shrimp and cook for 3 minutes until pink.
Toss in the spaghetti with a splash of pasta water, the lemon juice and parsley.
Serve topped with arugula.

title: Air-fryer lemon chicken thighs & potatoes
steps: Toss the potatoes with half the oil and half the salt.
Air fry the potatoes at 200°C (400°F) for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix the chicken with the remaining oil, the garlic, oregano, paprika, lemon zest and remaining salt.
Shake the basket, add the chicken on top of the potatoes and air fry for 15 minutes more.
Check the chicken is cooked through, with no pink juices.
While it cooks, boil or steam the broccoli for 4 minutes.
Squeeze the lemon juice over everything and serve.

title: Slow-cooker beef & bean chili
steps: Brown the beef in a dry frying pan over a high heat for 5 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon.
Tip the beef into the slow cooker with the onion, pepper, garlic and spices.
Stir in the tomato paste, chopped tomatoes and kidney beans.
Cover and cook on low for 6 hours (or high for 3 hours).
About 20 minutes before serving, cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Season the chili with salt.
Serve over rice with a spoonful of sour cream.

title: Slow-cooker BBQ pulled chicken buns
steps: Put the onion in the slow cooker and lay the chicken thighs on top.
Mix the barbecue sauce with the paprika and garlic powder and pour over the chicken.
Cover and cook on low for 4 hours, until the chicken pulls apart easily.
Shred the chicken with two forks and stir it through the sauce.
Mix the cabbage and carrot with the mayonnaise and lemon juice for a quick slaw.
Toast the buns, then fill with the pulled chicken and slaw.

title: Sheet-pan chicken fajitas
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Toss the chicken, peppers and onion with the oil, spices and salt on a large tray.
Spread everything out in a single layer and roast for 20 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Warm the tortillas in the oven for the last 3 minutes.
Squeeze the lime juice over the tray.
Fill the tortillas with chicken and veg and top with sour cream.

title: Honey-garlic chicken stir-fry
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Toss the chicken in the cornstarch.
Heat the oil in a wok over a high heat and stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the broccoli, pepper and a splash of water and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in the honey and soy sauce and bubble for 1 minute until sticky.
Serve over the rice, sprinkled with sesame seeds.

title: Chicken tikka masala
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Heat the oil in a large pan and brown the chicken for 4 minutes. Lift out onto a plate.
Add the onion to the pan and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic, ginger and curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Return the chicken, stir in the cream and simmer for 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Take off the heat and stir in the yogurt. Scatter with cilantro and serve with rice.

title: Air-fryer turkey meatballs & spaghetti
steps: Mix the turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, half the garlic, the oregano and salt. Roll into 20 meatballs.
Air fry at 190°C (375°F) for 12 minutes, shaking halfway, until browned and cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water for 10 minutes, or according to the pack.
Heat the oil in a pan and fry the remaining garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the passata and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the meatballs to the sauce and turn to coat.
Serve over the spaghetti, torn basil on top.

title: Turkey taco lettuce cups
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat and cook the onion for 3 minutes.
Add the turkey and cook for 6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the salsa and a splash of water and bubble for 2 minutes.
Mix the tomatoes and avocado with half the lime juice.
Spoon the turkey into lettuce leaves and top with the tomato and avocado.
Serve with the remaining lime in wedges.

title: Weeknight spaghetti bolognese
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic and beef and cook for 5 minutes, breaking up the meat, until browned.
Stir in the tomato paste, then the chopped tomatoes and oregano.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water for 10 minutes, or according to the pack.
Season the sauce with salt and loosen with a splash of pasta water.
Serve the sauce over the spaghetti with grated parmesan.

title: Beef & broccoli with rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Toss the beef with the cornstarch and 1 tbsp of the soy sauce.
Mix the remaining soy sauce with the sugar and 4 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok over a high heat and sear the beef for 2 minutes. Lift out.
Stir-fry the broccoli with a splash of water for 3 minutes, then add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the beef, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve with the rice.

title: Korean beef rice bowls
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, brown the beef in a large frying pan over a high heat for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Mix the gochujang, soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil, pour over the beef and bubble for 2 minutes.
Divide the rice between bowls and top with the beef.
Add the cucumber and kimchi on the side.
Finish with spring onions and sesame seeds.

title: One-pan chicken & chorizo rice
steps: Heat the oil in a large deep frying pan and brown the chicken for 5 minutes. Lift out.
Fry the chorizo for 2 minutes until it releases its oil.
Add the onion and pepper and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic, paprika, turmeric and rice for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and stock, return the chicken and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook for 15 minutes, without stirring, until the rice is tender.
Scatter over the peas, cover for 3 minutes more, then serve with lemon wedges.

title: Sausage & white bean casserole
steps: Heat the oil in a large casserole pan and brown the sausages for 6 minutes. Lift out and cut each into 3.
Add the onion and carrot to the pan and cook for 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, paprika and thyme for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock and return the sausages.
Simmer for 15 minutes until thick and the sausages are cooked through.
Warm the baguette in a low oven for 5 minutes.
Serve the casserole in bowls with chunks of bread.

title: Miso-glazed pork with sesame greens
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix the miso, honey and soy sauce and brush over the pork.
Roast the pork on a lined tray for 20 minutes, then rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and stir-fry the bok choy and garlic for 3 minutes.
Slice the pork and serve with the rice and greens, sprinkled with sesame seeds.

title: Bangers & mash with onion gravy
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and roast the sausages on a tray for 25 minutes, turning once.
Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan and cook the onions slowly for 12 minutes until soft and golden.
Stir the flour into the onions, then gradually add the stock and simmer for 5 minutes until thick. Stir in the mustard.
Cook the peas in boiling water for 3 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk. Season.
Serve the sausages on the mash with peas, and pour over the gravy.

title: Chicken Caesar-style salad
steps: Rub the chicken with half the oil and season.
Cook the chicken in a frying pan over a medium-high heat for 5 to 6 minutes on each side until cooked through. Rest, then slice.
Toss the bread cubes with the remaining oil and toast in the same pan for 4 minutes until crisp.
Whisk the yogurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, garlic, Worcestershire sauce and half the parmesan.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing.
Top with the chicken, croutons and the remaining parmesan.

title: Pesto chicken pasta
steps: Cook the penne in salted boiling water for 10 minutes, or according to the pack. Save a mugful of pasta water.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large frying pan and cook the chicken for 7 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Drain the pasta, add it to the pan with the pesto and a splash of pasta water and toss.
Serve topped with parmesan.

title: Thai basil chicken with fried egg
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Heat half the oil in a wok over a high heat and fry the garlic and chili for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and stir-fry for 4 minutes until cooked through.
Add the green beans, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Toss through the basil until just wilted.
In a separate pan, fry the eggs in the remaining oil for 2 to 3 minutes until crispy at the edges.
Serve the chicken over rice with a fried egg on top.

title: Beef kofta pittas with garlic yogurt
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Mix the beef, onion, half the garlic, the cumin, cinnamon, half the parsley and the salt.
Shape into 8 sausage shapes and place on a lined tray.
Bake for 15 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix the yogurt with the remaining garlic and a pinch of salt.
Toss the cucumber and tomato with the lemon juice and remaining parsley.
Warm the pitas, then fill with koftas, salad and garlic yogurt.

title: Berry overnight oats
steps: Stir the oats, chia seeds, milk and yogurt together in a bowl, or split between two jars.
Stir in the honey and half the berries.
Cover and chill overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
In the morning, loosen with a splash of milk and top with the rest of the berries.

title: Peanut butter & banana porridge
steps: Put the oats, milk and cinnamon in a small pan over a medium heat.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Loosen with a splash of water if it gets too thick.
Spoon into bowls and top with the banana slices.
Finish each bowl with a spoonful of peanut butter.

title: Spinach & tomato scrambled eggs on toast
steps: Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper.
Melt half the butter in a non-stick pan over a medium heat and soften the tomatoes for 2 minutes.
Add the spinach and stir until just wilted, then push everything to one side.
Toast the bread.
Melt the rest of the butter in the pan, pour in the eggs and stir slowly until softly set.
Pile the eggs and vegetables onto the toast and serve straight away.

title: Bean & egg breakfast burritos
steps: Warm the black beans in a small pan with a splash of water, lightly crushing them.
Beat the eggs with the salt and half the spring onion.
Scramble the eggs in a non-stick pan over a medium heat until just set.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds on each side.
Fill each tortilla with beans, eggs, cheese and salsa, then scatter over the rest of the spring onion.
Fold in the ends, roll up tightly and cut in half.

title: Smashed avocado toast with a fried egg
steps: Mash the avocado with the lime juice and salt.
Toast the bread.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and fry the eggs for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Spread the avocado over the toast.
Top each slice with an egg and a pinch of chilli flakes.

title: Greek yogurt berry bowl
steps: Leave the berries to thaw in a bowl for 10 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Spoon the yogurt into two bowls.
Top with the berries and their juice.
Drizzle with honey and scatter over the walnuts and chia seeds.

title: Berry chia pudding
steps: Whisk the chia seeds, soy milk and maple syrup together in a bowl.
Leave for 10 minutes, then whisk again so the seeds don't clump.
Cover and chill overnight, or for at least 3 hours, until thick.
Spoon into two bowls and top with the berries.

title: Berry & banana smoothie
steps: Peel the bananas and break them into the blender.
Add the frozen berries, soy milk and chia seeds.
Blend for 1 minute until completely smooth.
Pour into two glasses and drink straight away.

title: Sweet potato & pepper breakfast hash
steps: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat.
Add the sweet potato and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until starting to soften.
Add the onion and pepper and cook for 5 minutes more.
Stir in the paprika and black beans and cook for 2 minutes until hot.
Season with salt and serve.

title: Cinnamon French toast with berries
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk and cinnamon in a shallow dish.
Melt half the butter in a frying pan over a medium heat.
Dip two slices of bread in the egg mixture for a few seconds on each side.
Fry for 2 minutes on each side until golden. Repeat with the rest of the butter and bread.
Serve topped with the berries and a drizzle of maple syrup.

title: Turmeric tofu scramble
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and cook the spring onions and tomatoes for 2 minutes.
Crumble the tofu into the pan with your fingers.
Stir in the turmeric and salt and cook for 4 minutes until hot and golden.
Add the spinach and stir until just wilted.
Serve straight away.

title: Ham & cheese omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with half the spring onion.
Melt the butter in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and cook for 2 minutes, drawing the edges into the middle.
Scatter the ham and cheese over one half and cook for 1 minute more.
Fold the omelette over, cut in half and serve with the rest of the spring onion.

title: Chicken, hummus & spinach wraps
steps: Slice the chicken into thin strips and toss with the paprika and oil.
Fry in a pan over a medium-high heat for 6–8 minutes until cooked through.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds on each side.
Spread each tortilla with hummus.
Add the spinach, cucumber and chicken, then roll up tightly and cut in half.

title: Tuna & sweetcorn sandwiches
steps: Flake the tuna into a bowl.
Stir in the sweetcorn, mayonnaise and pepper.
Spread over two slices of bread and top with the cucumber.
Close the sandwiches and cut in half.

title: Greek salad with feta & chickpeas
steps: Put the cucumber, tomatoes, onion, chickpeas and olives in a large bowl.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and oregano together.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss well.
Crumble the feta over the top and serve.

title: Quinoa, black bean & avocado bowl
steps: Cook the quinoa in a pan of boiling water for 15 minutes, then drain well.
Meanwhile, warm the black beans in a small pan with a splash of water.
Toss the quinoa with the tomatoes, the juice of the lime and the salt.
Divide between two bowls and top with the beans and avocado.
Scatter over the cilantro and serve warm or cold.

title: Red lentil & carrot soup
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan over a medium heat and soften the onion and carrots for 6 minutes.
Stir in the cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and stock and bring to the boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils have collapsed.
Blend until smooth, loosening with a little water if needed.
Season with salt and serve.

title: Lemon couscous with halloumi
steps: Pour the hot stock over the couscous, cover and leave for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and stir in the juice of the lemon and the oil.
Fold in the tomatoes, cucumber and mint.
Fry the halloumi in a dry non-stick pan over a medium-high heat for 2 minutes on each side until golden.
Serve the couscous topped with the halloumi.

title: Ginger chicken noodle soup
steps: Bring the stock, ginger and carrot to a simmer in a large pan.
Add the whole chicken breast and poach gently for 12 minutes until cooked through.
Lift out the chicken and shred it with two forks.
Add the noodles to the pan and cook for 4 minutes.
Return the chicken, stir in the soy sauce and ladle into bowls.
Scatter over the spring onions.

title: Tomato, mozzarella & pesto toastie
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Spread pesto on the other side of two slices, then layer on the mozzarella and tomato.
Top with the remaining slices, buttered side out.
Cook in a frying pan over a medium heat for 3 minutes on each side until golden and melting.

title: Smashed chickpea salad sandwiches
steps: Roughly mash the chickpeas with a fork, leaving some whole.
Stir in the hummus, lemon juice and mustard.
Fold in the celery and onion.
Spread over two slices of bread, top with the rest and cut in half.

title: Microwave jacket potatoes with cheesy beans
steps: Prick the potatoes all over with a fork.
Microwave on high for 8–10 minutes, turning halfway, until soft all the way through.
Meanwhile, mix the beans, passata and paprika in a bowl and microwave for 2 minutes until hot.
Split the potatoes and add a little butter to each.
Spoon over the beans and top with the cheese.

title: Tuna & white bean salad
steps: Put the beans, onion and tomatoes in a bowl.
Dress with the juice of the lemon and the oil.
Fold through the arugula.
Flake the tuna over the top and scatter with parsley.

title: Sweet potato & black bean quesadillas
steps: Cook the grated sweet potato in a dry non-stick pan over a medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the cumin and beans, lightly crushing the beans, then tip into a bowl.
Spread the filling over two tortillas, scatter with cheese and top with the other tortillas.
Cook one at a time in the pan for 2–3 minutes on each side until crisp and melting.
Cut into wedges and serve with the salsa.

title: Hummus with veg sticks
steps: Cut the carrots, cucumber and pepper into sticks.
Spoon the hummus into a bowl and serve with the veg for dipping.

title: Apple slices with peanut butter
steps: Core the apples and cut each into 8 slices.
Spoon the peanut butter into a small bowl and dust with cinnamon.
Serve the apple slices with the peanut butter for dipping.

title: Stovetop paprika popcorn
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan with a lid over a medium-high heat with 3 kernels in it.
When they pop, add the rest of the kernels, cover and shake the pan.
Cook for 2–3 minutes, shaking often, until the popping slows to a few seconds apart.
Tip into a bowl and toss with the paprika and salt.

title: Oat & raisin energy balls
steps: Mix everything together in a bowl until it clumps.
Roll into 12 small balls with damp hands.
Chill for 20 minutes to firm up.
Keep in a sealed box in the fridge for up to 5 days.

title: Yogurt & berry pots
steps: Thaw the berries in a bowl for 10 minutes and lightly crush half of them.
Layer the yogurt and berries in four small glasses or pots.
Drizzle with honey before serving.

title: Rice cakes with avocado & chilli
steps: Mash the avocado with the lime juice and salt.
Spread over the rice cakes.
Finish with a pinch of chilli flakes.

title: Crispy spiced chickpeas
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Pat the chickpeas very dry with a clean tea towel.
Toss with the oil, paprika, cumin and salt on a baking tray.
Roast for 25–30 minutes, shaking the tray halfway, until crisp.
Leave to cool on the tray: they crisp up more as they cool.

title: Devilled eggs
steps: Lower the eggs into a pan of boiling water and cook for 10 minutes.
Cool in cold water, then peel and halve lengthways.
Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise and mustard until smooth.
Spoon back into the whites and dust with paprika.

title: Salmon rice bowl with sriracha mayo
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, adding the edamame for the last 3, then drain.
Brush the salmon with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the honey and bake on a lined tray for 12 minutes until it flakes.
Mix the mayonnaise and sriracha.
Flake the salmon into the hot rice and edamame with the rest of the soy sauce and mash it together, the way the viral version does — one fillet stretches to two bowls.
Top with cucumber, a zigzag of sriracha mayo and sesame seeds.
Scoop up each bite with a square of nori.

title: Spicy tuna crispy rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain well.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over a medium-high heat and press the rice in a flat layer.
Leave it alone for 6 minutes until the bottom is golden and crisp, then break into pieces.
Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise, sriracha and half the soy sauce.
Pile the crispy rice into bowls with the cucumber and avocado.
Spoon over the spicy tuna, add the rest of the soy sauce and finish with spring onion and nori.

title: Chicken burrito bowl with lime rice
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, drain and stir in the juice of 1 lime and half the cilantro.
Toss the chicken with the paprika, cumin, chili powder, oil and salt.
Cook in a frying pan over a medium-high heat for 6 minutes on each side until charred and cooked through.
Rest the chicken for 2 minutes, then slice.
Warm the black beans and sweetcorn in the same pan for 3 minutes.
Build the bowls: lime rice, beans and corn, chicken, salsa and avocado.
Top with sour cream, the rest of the cilantro and lime wedges.

title: Greek chicken bowl with tzatziki
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Toss the chicken with half the lemon juice, the oregano, two-thirds of the garlic, the oil and salt, and roast for 22–25 minutes until charred at the edges.
Pour 350 ml boiling water and the bouillon over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Grate half the cucumber, squeeze out the water and stir into the yogurt with the rest of the garlic and lemon. Dice the other half.
Slice the chicken and pile into bowls with couscous, cucumber, tomatoes and feta.
Spoon over the tzatziki.

title: Korean-style spicy pork rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Mix the gochujang, soy sauce, honey and garlic and toss with the pork.
Heat the oil in a large pan until very hot and fry the onion for 2 minutes.
Add the pork in one layer and leave for 2 minutes to char, then stir-fry for 3 minutes until sticky and cooked.
Spoon over the rice with the cucumber.
Finish with spring onions and sesame seeds.

title: Cajun chicken rice bowl with corn & lime yogurt
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Toss the chicken with the spices and salt.
Fry in the oil over a high heat for 8 minutes until blackened at the edges and cooked through, then set aside.
Add the corn and pepper to the hot pan and char for 5 minutes.
Mix the yogurt with the juice of 1 lime.
Serve the chicken over the rice with the charred corn, lime yogurt, spring onions and lime wedges.

title: Crispy tofu poke-style bowl
steps: Toss the tofu with 1 tbsp soy sauce, then with the cornstarch.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 15 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, adding the edamame for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Whisk the rest of the soy sauce with the vinegar, sesame oil and sriracha.
Arrange the rice, edamame, carrot, cucumber and mango in bowls.
Add the crispy tofu, drizzle with the dressing and scatter with sesame seeds.

title: Baked falafel hummus bowl
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, most of the parsley, the spices, flour and salt in a blender until coarse.
Shape into 16 small patties and put on an oiled tray. Brush with the rest of the oil.
Bake for 25 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp outside.
Meanwhile, cover the bulgur with 400 ml boiling water and leave for 15 minutes, then fluff.
Toss the cucumber and tomato with the lemon juice and the rest of the parsley.
Spread hummus in each bowl, add the bulgur, salad and falafel.

title: Smoky chickpea & sweet potato bowl
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Toss the sweet potato, chickpeas and onion with the oil, paprika, cumin and salt on a large tray.
Roast for 30 minutes, shaking halfway, until the chickpeas are crisp.
Meanwhile, simmer the quinoa in 500 ml water for 15 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and 3 tbsp water into a pourable sauce.
Massage the kale with a pinch of salt for 1 minute to soften.
Fill bowls with quinoa, kale and the roast tray, then drizzle with tahini sauce.

title: Salmon sushi bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Cook the rice for 12 minutes, drain and stir in the vinegar and sugar.
Bake the salmon on a lined tray for 12 minutes, then flake it.
Mix the salmon with the cream cheese, 2 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Press the rice into a baking dish, spread over the salmon and bake for 8 minutes until golden.
Drizzle with the rest of the mayonnaise mixed with the sriracha, the rest of the soy and sesame.
Scoop onto squares of nori with cucumber.

title: Baked feta tomato pasta
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Tip the tomatoes and garlic into a baking dish and put the block of feta in the middle.
Drizzle with the oil, sprinkle with chili flakes and pepper, and bake for 30 minutes until the tomatoes burst.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta in salted boiling water, saving a mug of the water before you drain it.
Mash the feta, garlic and tomatoes together into a creamy sauce.
Stir in the spinach, the pasta and a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Tear over the basil and serve.

title: Sheet-pan crispy gnocchi with peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Tip the gnocchi straight from the pack onto a large tray with the peppers, onion and tomatoes.
Toss with the oil, herbs and salt and spread out in one layer.
Roast for 20 minutes, shaking halfway, until the gnocchi are crisp.
Dot with the mozzarella and roast for 5 more minutes until melted.
Drizzle with pesto and serve straight from the tray.

title: Air-fryer popcorn chicken rice bowl
steps: Coat the chicken in the yogurt and salt.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the paprika and garlic powder, then roll the chicken in them.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 12–15 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice and mayonnaise.
Warm the honey and sriracha together and toss with the chicken.
Serve the chicken over rice with the slaw.

title: Hot honey chicken & sweet potato bowl
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Toss the chicken and sweet potato with the oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt on a large tray.
Roast for 15 minutes, then add the broccoli and roast for 15 minutes more.
Warm the honey with the hot sauce and chili flakes.
Brush the hot honey over the chicken for the last 3 minutes.
Mix the yogurt with the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Slice the chicken and serve over the vegetables with the lime yogurt.

title: Creamy Tuscan-style chicken orzo
steps: Season the chicken with the herbs and salt.
Heat the oil in a deep pan and cook the chicken for 4 minutes on each side until golden, then set aside.
Add the garlic, peppers and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the orzo and stock and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in the cream and parmesan, then nestle the chicken back in for 3 minutes until cooked through.
Stir through the spinach until wilted and serve.

title: Butter chicken meal-prep bowl
steps: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, garam masala and salt.
Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Melt the butter in a deep pan and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, then pour in the passata.
Simmer for 12 minutes, then stir in the cream.
Split between 4 containers with the rice and scatter with cilantro.

title: Spicy shrimp taco bowl
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, adding the corn for the last 3, then drain.
Toss the shrimp with the spices and salt.
Cook in the oil over a high heat for 2 minutes on each side until pink and charred.
Toss the cabbage with half the lime juice.
Build the bowls with rice and corn, slaw, shrimp and salsa.
Squeeze over the rest of the lime.

title: Burger bowl with special sauce
steps: Boil the potato cubes for 8 minutes until just tender, then drain.
Fry them in the oil in a large pan over a high heat for 6 minutes until crisp, then set aside.
Brown the beef and onion in the same pan for 8 minutes, seasoning with the garlic powder and salt.
Stir the mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard and a splash of the cucumber juice into a special sauce.
Fill the bowls with lettuce, tomato and cucumber.
Add the beef, crispy potatoes and cheddar, then drizzle over the sauce.

title: Turkey taco sweet potato bowl
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Toss the sweet potato with the oil and a pinch of salt and roast for 28 minutes until golden.
Meanwhile, brown the turkey and onion in a large pan for 8 minutes.
Add the chili powder and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 10 minutes. Season with salt.
Mix the yogurt with half the lime juice.
Serve the spinach topped with sweet potato, turkey chili and the lime yogurt.

title: Thai peanut chicken bowl
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, juice of 1 lime, honey and 4 tbsp hot water into a smooth sauce.
Fry the chicken in the oil over a high heat for 6 minutes until golden and cooked.
Pour in half the sauce and toss for 1 minute.
Fill the bowls with rice, cabbage and carrot and add the chicken.
Drizzle with the rest of the sauce and finish with peanuts and lime wedges.

title: Air-fryer crispy fish taco bowl
steps: Cook the rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Toss the fish in 3 tbsp of the yogurt, then in the breadcrumbs mixed with the paprika and salt.
Air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 10 minutes until golden and flaky.
Toss the cabbage with the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt.
Stir the hot sauce into the rest of the yogurt.
Serve the fish over rice with the slaw, spicy yogurt and lime wedges.

title: Crispy pesto gnocchi with peas
steps: Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan over a medium-high heat.
Add the gnocchi straight from the pack in one layer and leave for 4 minutes until golden underneath.
Toss and cook for 4 minutes more until crisp all over.
Add the peas, tomatoes and a splash of water and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then the pesto and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve topped with the parmesan.

title: Sheet-pan chickpea shawarma bowl
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Toss the chickpeas, cauliflower and onion with the oil, spices and salt on a large tray.
Roast for 25 minutes, shaking halfway, until charred at the edges.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice and 3 tbsp water until smooth.
Warm the pitas in the oven for the last 2 minutes and cut into strips.
Pile the tray into bowls with the cucumber and parsley.
Drizzle with tahini sauce and serve with the warm pita.

title: Kimchi fried rice with a jammy egg
steps: Lower the eggs into boiling water for 6½ minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Heat the sesame oil in a large frying pan over a high heat.
Fry the kimchi, garlic and most of the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Add the rice, gochujang and soy sauce and stir-fry for 4 minutes until the rice starts to crisp.
Spoon into bowls and halve the eggs on top.
Finish with nori, sesame seeds and the rest of the spring onion.

title: Black bean enchilada skillet
steps: Heat the oil in a large lidded pan and cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cumin and chili powder for 30 seconds.
Add the passata, beans, sweetcorn and salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the torn tortillas until coated.
Scatter over the cheese, cover and cook for 4 minutes until melted.
Top with avocado and cilantro and serve from the pan.

title: Spicy creamy tomato pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water, saving a mug of the water before you drain it.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan and cook the onion for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic, tomato paste and chili flakes and fry for 3 minutes until brick red.
Stir in the cream and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the pasta, parmesan and a splash of pasta water and toss until silky.
Season with pepper and tear over the basil.

title: Egg roll in a bowl
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan over a high heat and brown the pork for 6 minutes until crispy.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the cabbage and carrot and stir-fry for 4 minutes until just soft but still crunchy.
Stir in the soy sauce.
Heat the rice and mix the sriracha with the mayonnaise.
Serve the pork and cabbage over rice with sriracha mayo, spring onions and sesame.

title: Garlic butter noodles with crispy chicken
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water, saving a mug of water before draining.
Season the chicken with salt and fry in the oil over a high heat for 7 minutes until crisp and cooked, then set aside.
Turn the heat down, add the butter and garlic and cook gently for 2 minutes until golden and smelling amazing — don't let it burn.
Stir in the soy sauce and honey.
Toss in the spaghetti, parmesan and a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Top with the chicken and lots of spring onion.

title: One-pan lemon salmon & pea orzo
steps: Season the salmon and cook in the oil, skin-side down, for 4 minutes in a deep lidded pan, then lift out.
Add the garlic and orzo and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in 750 ml boiling water and the bouillon and simmer for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the peas, spinach and the lemon zest and juice.
Sit the salmon on top, cover and cook for 4 minutes, then break it into big flakes through the orzo.
Finish with parmesan.

title: Crispy tofu satay noodle bowl
steps: Toss the tofu in the cornstarch.
Fry in the oil in a non-stick pan for 10 minutes, turning, until crisp all over.
Meanwhile, soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 8 minutes, then drain.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, maple syrup and 4 tbsp hot water into a satay sauce.
Add the bok choy to the pan with a splash of water for 2 minutes.
Toss the noodles with half the sauce and top with tofu, bok choy, bean sprouts and spring onions, then drizzle with the rest.

title: Smashed cucumber salad with edamame rice
steps: Smash the cucumber with a rolling pin until it cracks, then break into chunks.
Toss with the salt and leave for 5 minutes, then drain off the water.
Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, chili flakes and sugar.
Microwave the rice and the edamame for 3 minutes, covered.
Toss the cucumber in the dressing and pile it over the edamame rice with the sesame seeds.

title: Chopped Italian-style sandwich
steps: Pile the ham, mozzarella, lettuce, tomato and onion on a big board.
Chop everything together until it's finely mixed.
Add the mayonnaise, vinegar, oregano and pepper and chop again to mix.
Split the baguette, pile in the filling and cut in half.

title: Green goddess salad with pita chips
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and bake the pita triangles for 8 minutes until crisp.
Blend the spinach, basil, lemon juice, oil, garlic, parmesan, salt and 3 tbsp water until smooth.
Toss the chopped cabbage, cucumber and spring onions in the green dressing.
Scoop it up with the pita chips.

title: Dense bean salad
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard, oregano and salt in a large bowl.
Add the beans and chickpeas and toss to coat.
Stir in the cucumber, onion, peppers, feta and parsley.
Leave for 10 minutes before eating, or pack into jars for the week.

title: Cottage cheese flatbread wrap
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a tray with baking paper.
Whisk the cottage cheese, eggs, garlic powder, herbs and salt until smooth, then spread into a thin rectangle.
Bake for 30 minutes until set and golden at the edges, then cool for 5 minutes and cut in half.
Fill each half with ham, lettuce and tomato and roll up.

title: High-protein tuna pasta salad
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until just tender, then rinse under cold water and drain.
Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, mustard and salt into a dressing.
Flake in the tuna and stir.
Add the pasta, sweetcorn, tomatoes, cucumber and spring onion and toss.
Split into containers and chill until lunch.

title: Rice paper rolls with peanut dip
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil for 6 minutes until golden, adding 1 tbsp soy sauce at the end.
Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 5 minutes, then drain and cool.
Dip a rice paper wrapper in warm water for 10 seconds, fill with noodles, tofu, carrot and cucumber, fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Repeat.
Whisk the peanut butter with the rest of the soy sauce, the lime juice and 2 tbsp hot water to dip.

title: Crispy chicken Caesar wrap
steps: Cook the chicken in the oil in a frying pan for 5 minutes on each side until cooked through, then slice.
Whisk the mayonnaise, yogurt, lemon juice, mustard, garlic, pepper and half the parmesan.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing and the rest of the parmesan.
Fill the tortillas with the salad and chicken and roll up tightly.
Toast seam-side down in the dry pan for 1 minute on each side, then cut in half.

title: Crispy halloumi couscous salad
steps: Cover the couscous with 150 ml boiling water and a pinch of salt for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Fry the halloumi in a dry non-stick pan for 2 minutes on each side until golden.
Whisk the lemon juice, oil and honey and toss with the couscous, tomatoes, cucumber and spinach.
Top with the hot halloumi.

title: Caprese orzo salad
steps: Cook the orzo in salted boiling water for 9 minutes, then rinse under cold water and drain.
Whisk the oil, balsamic, garlic and salt.
Toss the orzo with the tomatoes and dressing.
Fold through the mozzarella and torn basil just before eating.

title: Buffalo chicken lettuce wraps
steps: Cook the chicken in the oil for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Add the hot sauce and butter and toss until glossy.
Mix the yogurt with the garlic powder, thyme and a pinch of salt for a quick ranch.
Spoon the chicken into lettuce cups with celery and carrot and drizzle with the ranch.

title: Roasted red pepper soup with feta toast
steps: Heat the oil in a pan and cook the onion for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the peppers, tomatoes and stock and simmer for 12 minutes.
Blend until smooth and season with salt.
Toast the sourdough and pile the crumbled feta on top.
Serve the soup with the feta toast for dunking.

title: Peanut noodle salad
steps: Soak the noodles in just-boiled water for 8 minutes, adding the edamame for the last 3, then rinse under cold water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, lime juice and 3 tbsp hot water.
Toss the noodles and edamame with the cabbage, carrot and dressing.
Scatter with peanuts and pack into jars for the week.

title: Mediterranean chickpea quinoa bowl
steps: Simmer the quinoa in 500 ml water for 15 minutes until absorbed, then spread out to cool.
Whisk the lemon juice, oil, oregano and salt.
Toss the quinoa, chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes and onion in the dressing.
Top with feta.

title: Blended berry baked oats
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Blend the oats, banana, egg, milk, baking powder and maple syrup until smooth.
Pour into two small oven dishes and press in the berries.
Bake for 25 minutes until risen and golden like a cake.

title: Cottage cheese egg bites
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (325°F) and oil 8 holes of a muffin tin.
Blend the eggs, cottage cheese and salt until silky.
Divide the spinach and cheddar between the holes, pour over the egg and bake for 22 minutes until just set.
Cool for 5 minutes before popping out. They keep 4 days in the fridge.

title: Chocolate peanut butter overnight oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt and peanut butter together.
Stir in most of the grated chocolate and half the banana, mashed.
Split between two jars, cover and chill overnight.
Top with the rest of the banana and chocolate.

title: Mango coconut chia pudding
steps: Whisk the chia seeds, coconut milk, soy milk and maple syrup and leave for 5 minutes.
Whisk again to break up any clumps, then chill for at least 4 hours.
Blend half the mango with the lime juice into a purée.
Layer the pudding with the mango purée and top with the rest of the mango, diced.

title: Three-ingredient banana oat pancakes
steps: Blend the bananas, eggs and oats until smooth and leave for 2 minutes to thicken.
Wipe a non-stick pan with a little oil over a medium heat.
Pour in small pancakes and cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear, then flip for 1 minute.
Stack with yogurt and a drizzle of maple syrup.

title: Crispy feta egg wrap
steps: Scatter half the feta in a non-stick pan over a medium heat and pour over half the egg.
When the egg is almost set, press a tortilla on top and cook for 1 minute.
Flip and cook for 1 minute more until the feta is crisp.
Fill with spinach, avocado, chili flakes and hot sauce, fold and repeat.

title: Thick berry smoothie bowl
steps: Blend the berries, 1½ bananas, yogurt and milk until very thick, scraping down as you go.
Spoon into two bowls.
Slice the rest of the banana on top.
Toast the oats in a dry pan for 2 minutes and scatter over for crunch.

title: Savory cottage cheese toast
steps: Toast the sourdough.
Spread thickly with the cottage cheese.
Top with the tomato slices.
Mix the sesame seeds, garlic powder and chili and sprinkle over with the oil and pepper.

title: Frozen yogurt berry bark
steps: Mix the yogurt with the honey and spread on a lined tray about 1 cm thick.
Scatter over the berries and drizzle with the melted chocolate.
Freeze for at least 3 hours.
Snap into shards and eat straight from the freezer.

title: Frozen lime grapes
steps: Wash and dry the grapes, then pull them off the stalks.
Toss with the lime zest and juice and the sugar.
Spread on a tray and freeze for 2 hours until icy like sorbet.

title: Cucumber tuna sushi bites
steps: Mix the tuna with the cream cheese, sriracha and soy sauce.
Spoon a little onto each cucumber slice.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve cold.

title: Two-minute chocolate cottage cheese mousse
steps: Melt the chocolate in the microwave in 20-second bursts.
Blend the cottage cheese, melted chocolate and honey until completely smooth.
Spoon into two glasses and chill for 10 minutes.

title: Banana peanut butter sushi
steps: Spread the tortilla with the peanut butter.
Lay the banana at one edge and roll it up tightly.
Slice into 8 rounds and sprinkle with chia seeds.

title: Air-fryer cinnamon apple chips
steps: Toss the apple slices with the cinnamon and sugar.
Spread in a single layer in the air-fryer basket, in batches if needed.
Air-fry at 150°C (300°F) for 12–15 minutes, flipping halfway.
Leave to cool for 5 minutes. They crisp up as they cool.

title: Chili garlic edamame
steps: Boil the edamame for 4 minutes, then drain well.
Warm the sesame oil in a pan and fry the garlic and chili for 30 seconds.
Toss in the edamame with the soy sauce and salt and serve warm.

title: Chili lime mango
steps: Cut the mango into thick spears or cubes.
Squeeze over the lime juice.
Sprinkle with the chili powder and salt and eat straight away.
